definition.en: The Human Development Report is an annual publication by the United Nations Development Programme that assesses global progress in human development using the Human Development Index (HDI).
definition.hi: The Human Development Report is an annual publication by the United Nations Development Programme that assesses global progress in human development using the Human Development Index (HDI).

importanceInUpsc.en: The HDR is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a multidimensional perspective on poverty, inequality, and social welfare beyond mere GDP growth. Understanding India's performance in these indices is essential for answering questions on inclusive growth, social sector policy, and governance.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the methodology and components of the Human Development Index.
